_readme: Source for scripts/write-vat-policy.js. Every null below is an OWNER / TAX-ADVISER decision (docs/VAT_POLICY_2026-09-30.md §2). The writer refuses to write while any decision field is null. Code never infers VAT: until these documents exist in production, commission invoices REFUSE and subscription invoices DEFER.

revenueConfig/commission_vat._supply: SOKONI commission (marketplace 15%, POS 5%, provider ladder, hub rates, flat property/vehicle fees) — supplier SOKONI, recipient merchant/provider

_options.inclusive: boolean, required only when applicability = taxable

_evidence_to_resolve: SOKONI VAT registration status (VAT Act 2013 s.34) — not in the repository; ETIMS_PLATFORM_PIN is a secret
terms.html:255 says the 16% VAT on platform fees is deducted (inclusive); legal-hub.html:3228 reads as charged on top (exclusive) — pick one, fix the other page

revenueConfig/subscription_vat._supply: SOKONI subscription fee (sub-billing PLANS prices) — supplier SOKONI, recipient subscriber

_options.inclusive: boolean, required only when applicability = taxable

_evidence_to_resolve: advertised plan prices read as consumer prices (inclusive) — a decision, not an assumption
